title: Replay Failures as Successes: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following
authors_zh: Kongcheng Zhang、Qi Yao、Shunyu Liu、Wenjian Zhang、Min Cen、Yang Zhou、Wenkai Fang、Yiru Zhao、Baisheng Lai、Mingli Song
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: HiR selects partially successful failed rollouts, rewrites them from satisfied constraints, and replays them during RL.
HiR 挑出部分成功的失败采样，按其已满足的约束改写它们，并在强化学习中回放。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）
why: Selection and rewriting signals need retention to audit failure-to-data transformations.
inclusion_reason: An explicit transformation from partially successful failure trajectories into replay data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Binary reward is sparse for multi-constraint instruction following: satisfying four of five constraints receives the same zero as satisfying none. Averaged constraint reward is denser, but directly optimizing partial credit can blur the distinction between complete compliance and a response that repeatedly satisfies only easy constraints. HiR asks how information in a partial failure can become a successful replay experience without claiming that it solved the original task.

The central data question is attribution. A response, its original instruction, all atomic constraints, per-constraint decisions, and the rewritten instruction must remain linked. If only the relabeled success is retained, later users cannot tell which constraints were removed, whether the checks were reliable, or whether the model learned full instruction following rather than a distribution of easier pseudo-instructions.

多约束指令遵循中的二元奖励很稀疏：满足五项约束中的四项，与一项都不满足，都会得到 0。约束平均分虽更稠密，但直接优化部分分数会模糊“完全遵循”与“反复只满足容易约束”的区别。HiR 研究如何把部分失败中的信息转成成功 replay experience，同时不声称它完成了原始任务。

核心数据问题是归因。回答、原始指令、全部原子约束、逐约束判断和改写指令必须保持关联。若只保留重标后的成功记录，后续使用者就无法判断删除了哪些约束、检查是否可靠，或模型学到的是完整指令遵循还是更容易的伪指令分布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
HiR leaves a sampled response unchanged and rewrites only its conditioning instruction. The pseudo-instruction contains the constraints that the response was judged to satisfy and omits the unmet constraints. The same text that receives zero under the complete original instruction can therefore receive one under a strictly narrower hindsight instruction; success is conditional on the relabeled task, not retroactive success on the original task.

Selection uses constraint-level feedback together with response entropy. Only partial outcomes with a satisfied-constraint fraction strictly between zero and one are eligible, and a scheduled curriculum score balances constraint integrity with uncertainty. Original and hindsight samples then enter a Reinforce++-style update with binary rewards, creating contrast in both response space and instruction space.

The feedback contract is mixed. Hard constraints use deterministic rules or executable checks; soft constraints use DeepSeek-V3.1 in non-thinking mode as a learned judge. A replay record is therefore auditable only if it preserves the constraint type, checker/judge version, individual decisions, rewritten prompt, unchanged response, selection score, and replay flag.

HiR 保持采样回答不变，只改写其条件指令。伪指令包含被判定已满足的约束，并删除未满足约束。因此，同一文本在完整原指令下得到 0，却可在严格更窄的 hindsight 指令下得到 1；这里的成功只属于重标任务，不是原任务被追认成功。

选择过程同时使用逐约束反馈与 response entropy。只有满足约束比例严格位于 0 和 1 之间的部分结果有资格进入 replay，调度式 curriculum 分数在约束完整度与不确定性之间权衡。原始样本与 hindsight 样本随后共同进入 Reinforce++ 风格更新并使用二元奖励，从而在回答空间和指令空间都形成对比。

反馈契约是混合型：硬约束使用确定性规则或可执行检查，软约束使用 DeepSeek-V3.1 non-thinking 作为学习型 judge。因此，可审计 replay 记录必须保留约束类型、checker/judge 版本、逐项决定、改写 prompt、未改回答、选择分数与 replay 标记。

title: Method
方法
html:
HIR-16K is constructed from MulDimIF, VerIF, IFTrain, Chatbot Arena, and additional programmatic constraint synthesis. The paper reports about 16K queries with more than five decomposable constraints each. The public dataset rows expose the prompt, criteria, checker metadata, source, and identifier. Exact upstream revisions, source-wise counts, deduplication across sources, and contamination checks are not disclosed in the checked Card.

During RL, the policy samples candidate responses and obtains per-constraint outcomes. Candidates whose dense satisfaction is exactly zero or one are excluded from hindsight selection; partial failures are ranked by a scheduled combination of entropy and the fraction of satisfied constraints. The chosen response is copied unchanged, unmet constraints are removed from the prompt, and a replay indicator distinguishes the relabeled sample.

Original and replayed samples share the subsequent Reinforce++-style update, but their success predicates differ. Original samples require the full constraint set; replayed samples require the retained subset. The checked public HIR-16K artifact is a prompt-and-constraint release, not a release of policy rollouts, selected/rejected replay candidates, rewritten prompts, entropy values, training-step rewards, or checkpoint-linked replay buffers.

HIR-16K 来自 MulDimIF、VerIF、IFTrain、Chatbot Arena 和额外程序化约束合成。论文报告约 16K 个 query，每条包含五个以上可分解约束。公开数据行暴露 prompt、criteria、checker metadata、source 与标识。已核查卡片没有披露精确上游版本、分来源数量、跨来源去重或污染检查。

RL 中，策略采样候选回答并获得逐约束结果。稠密满足度恰为 0 或 1 的候选不进入 hindsight 选择；部分失败按 entropy 与已满足约束比例的调度组合排序。选中回答原样复制，prompt 删除未满足约束，并用 replay indicator 标记重标样本。

原始与 replay 样本共同进入 Reinforce++ 风格更新，但成功判据不同：原始样本要求完整约束集，replay 样本只要求保留子集。公开 HIR-16K 是 prompt 与约束发布，不包含策略 rollout、接受/拒绝 replay 候选、改写 prompt、entropy、训练步奖励或 checkpoint 对应 replay buffer。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper and repository specify the select-then-rewrite transformation, hard/soft constraint split, curriculum inputs, and RL integration. The official HIR-16K dataset exposes prompt, criteria, checker metadata, source, and ID and declares Apache-2.0. At the time recorded by this Card, the Hugging Face viewer reports a schema-casting failure, so availability of repository files should not be conflated with a healthy viewer or a fully audited schema.

The paper reports multi-backbone comparisons and ablations for selection, replay, and curriculum components. They support method utility in the tested model/evaluation settings. They do not prove that every atomic criterion is correctly specified, that the learned judge is calibrated, that hard checkers are robust, or that the public prompt mixture is uncontaminated.

No checked official artifact exposes full rollout groups, per-constraint decisions for generated responses, rejected replay candidates, rewritten online samples, entropy/selection scores, or checkpoint-linked reward logs. These are the records needed to audit the failure-to-success transformation itself.

官方论文与仓库说明了“选择后改写”的转换、硬/软约束划分、curriculum 输入和 RL 集成。官方 HIR-16K 公开 prompt、criteria、checker metadata、source 与 ID，并声明 Apache-2.0。本卡片记录时，Hugging Face viewer 报告 schema cast 失败，因此仓库文件存在不能等同于 viewer 正常或 schema 已完整审计。

论文报告多 backbone 比较，以及 selection、replay 与 curriculum 组件消融。这些结果支持方法在所测模型/评测设置中的效用，却不能证明每条原子 criterion 都正确、学习型 judge 已校准、硬 checker 足够稳健或公开 prompt 混合无污染。

已核查官方产物没有公开完整 rollout group、生成回答的逐约束决定、被拒 replay 候选、在线改写样本、entropy/选择分数或 checkpoint 对应奖励日志，而这些正是审计“失败转成功”转换所需的记录。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The central transformation is hindsight instruction relabeling rather than response correction or direct partial-credit optimization. A failed response becomes successful only under an explicitly weaker instruction whose retained constraints were judged satisfied. Because response tokens do not change, the new supervision attributes success to a change in task definition rather than to an edited solution.

The method creates contrast at two levels. Response-level preference distinguishes outputs under an original instruction, while instruction-level preference distinguishes the complete task from a hindsight task matched to the observed response. The scheduled mixture of entropy and constraint integrity also treats selection as a curriculum decision rather than replaying every partial failure.

This design is useful precisely because it preserves failure information, but it can be misreported easily. “Replay failures as successes” does not mean the original failure label was wrong; it means the record is paired with a different terminal predicate. A high-quality release must preserve both predicates and their provenance.

核心转换是 hindsight instruction relabeling，而不是修改回答或直接优化部分分数。失败回答只在显式更弱、且保留约束被判定满足的指令下变成成功。由于回答 token 不变，新监督把成功归因于任务定义变化，而不是编辑后的解答。

该方法在两个层面形成对比：回答级偏好区分同一原指令下的输出，指令级偏好则区分完整任务与适配当前回答的 hindsight 任务。entropy 与约束完整度的调度混合还把选择变成 curriculum 决策，而不是重放每个部分失败。

这种设计的价值恰在于保留失败信息，但也很容易被误述。“把失败重放为成功”不代表原失败标签错误，而是记录被配上不同的终止判据。高质量发布必须同时保留两种判据及其来源。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Removing unmet constraints shifts the task distribution and does not directly teach satisfaction of the full original request. Repeated replay may overrepresent easier subsets or encourage policies whose responses are easy to relabel. The Card does not identify a released audit of how often constraints are removed, which constraint types survive, or whether the pseudo-instruction distribution stays representative.

Entropy measures policy uncertainty, not semantic diversity, difficulty, or data quality. Its interaction with response length and decoding settings requires calibration. The learned judge may introduce systematic bias for soft constraints, while deterministic rules can be brittle to formatting or incomplete criterion specifications. Per-constraint human validation and checker error rates are unknown.

Exact source revisions, source-wise counts, deduplication, decontamination, train/evaluation overlap, full rollout groups, rejected replay candidates, judge/checker versions, rollout budgets, seeds, and checkpoint linkage are not released. Apache-2.0 declarations cover the official artifacts, but compatibility with every upstream prompt source and rights for generated outputs remain to be established.

删除未满足约束会改变任务分布，并不直接教会模型满足完整原请求。反复 replay 可能过度表示容易子集，甚至鼓励产生“容易重标”的回答。本卡片没有核实到约束删除频率、哪些类型更常保留，或伪指令分布是否仍具代表性的公开审计。

entropy 衡量策略不确定性，不等于语义多样性、难度或数据质量；它还需要结合回答长度和解码设置校准。学习型 judge 会给软约束带来系统偏差，确定性规则也可能对格式敏感或 criterion 不完整。逐约束人工验证与 checker 误差率均为 unknown。

精确来源版本、分来源数量、去重、去污染、训练/评测重叠、完整 rollout group、被拒 replay 候选、judge/checker 版本、rollout 预算、随机种子与 checkpoint 关联均未发布。Apache-2.0 声明覆盖官方产物，但每个上游 prompt 来源的兼容性和生成输出权利仍需确认。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
HiR is useful for failure-to-data pipelines where a response satisfies an auditable subset of atomic constraints. It supplies a general question for replay design: can the outcome be relabeled without changing the response, and can the weaker terminal predicate be stated exactly? This applies beyond instruction following only when subgoals and their checks are independently meaningful.

Reusable records should preserve the original task, all constraints, per-constraint decisions, checker or judge identity/version, entropy and selection scores, rewritten instruction, unchanged response, replay flag, reward, rollout group, checkpoint, and training step. Both selected and rejected partial failures are needed to audit curriculum bias.

The public HIR-16K prompt-and-constraint artifact can support instruction and checker research, but it is not the online replay corpus. Reusers should repair/verify the published schema, pin upstream revisions, and avoid claiming reproduction of HiR training without policy rollouts and rewrite logs.

HiR 适用于“回答满足可审计原子约束子集”的失败转数据流程。它为 replay 设计提出一个通用问题：能否在不改变回答的情况下重标结果，并精确定义更弱终止判据？只有当子目标及其检查可独立解释时，这一思路才适合推广到其他领域。

可复用记录应保留原任务、全部约束、逐约束决定、checker/judge 身份与版本、entropy/选择分数、改写指令、未改回答、replay 标记、奖励、rollout group、checkpoint 与训练步。接受和拒绝的部分失败都需要保留，才能审计 curriculum 偏差。

公开 HIR-16K prompt/constraint 产物可支持指令与 checker 研究，却不是在线 replay 语料。复用者应修复并核验公开 schema、固定上游版本，并避免在缺少策略 rollout 与 rewrite 日志时声称复现 HiR 训练。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep HIR-16K, the policy rollout stream, and the selected hindsight samples as three different objects. Only the prompt-and-constraint dataset is publicly linked here.
  • Hard constraints use rules or code; soft constraints use a learned judge. Preserve the constraint type and checker/judge version per decision.
  • Replay changes the instruction, not the response. The audit link among original prompt, all criteria, per-criterion outcomes, rewritten prompt, and unchanged response is essential.
  • Success under a pseudo-instruction is not success under the original instruction; each has a different terminal predicate.
  • Entropy is a curriculum feature, not a data-quality score. Check its dependence on length, decoding, and checkpoint.
  • Audit the viewer/schema failure, exact source revisions, upstream licenses, rejected candidates, rollout groups, and judge/checker error behavior before reuse.

• 将 HIR-16K、策略 rollout 流和被选 hindsight 样本视为三个不同对象；本卡片公开链接的只有 prompt/constraint 数据集。
  • 硬约束使用规则或代码，软约束使用学习型 judge；每次决定都应保留约束类型与 checker/judge 版本。
  • replay 改写指令，不修改回答；原 prompt、全部 criteria、逐项结果、改写 prompt 和未改回答之间的审计链不可缺失。
  • 伪指令下成功不等于原指令下成功，二者终止判据不同。
  • entropy 是 curriculum 特征，不是数据质量分数；应检查它对长度、解码和 checkpoint 的依赖。
  • 复用前审计 viewer/schema 故障、精确来源版本、上游许可、拒绝候选、rollout group 与 judge/checker 误差行为。
